scope: Tap-only command equivalence for exact no-identifier button aliases in one full runtime snapshot
proof: normalizeNode publishes its normalized frame unchanged and initializes metadata without an activationPoint. The full capture contains these public frames.

Viewport handling uses one application/window viewport for all elements. It does not change public frames. Its only activationPoint override is a deterministic function of public frame, role, action set and that viewport; there is no parent-specific point override. The Nolan center y=132 is below the bottom-clipped-zone threshold of 889.08, so neither alias has an override.

Both aliases have the same AXe element type Button and duplicate the same label, with no identifier or value. The pinned semantic-tap selector chooser therefore returns null for both and uses coordinate mode.

For a button, the default activation point is the rounded center of the public frame: (42,132). The pinned pure createSemanticTapCommand returned identical coordinate args for e30 and e117 from this capture. The AXe command adds the same simulator UDID. No elementRef is sent to AXe.
